snippet.title: Prince of Egypt - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Rise from a dying slave to a powerful noble in Ancient Egypt. Survive the desert, master trade, forge alliances, fight or steal your way to influence, and help build monuments that will shape an empire.
